description:
PR 2 of 4 under zaq-rn4.
User goal: Receive files through supported channels and know whether delivery succeeded.
Source implementation: 814ca7a83b00356e8f1bd8e2155f159a371ae641 (feat/channel-files). Copy existing lines and tests; preserve behavior. No independent rewrite.

Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add: lib/zaq/channels/{api,bridge,communication_bridge,delivery_files,delivery_error,delivery_confirmation,email_bridge,jido_chat_bridge,events}.ex; email_bridge/smtp_sender.ex; jido_chat_bridge/adapter_options.ex; required Engine notification/email configuration dispatch hunks. Include minimal delivery history contracts when transport requires them; defer full transcript integration to PR4. This is the initial ownership map; verify source hunks and dependency closure before extraction. Earlier slices own shared prerequisites.
Tests to add before implementation: copy existing source scenarios into this slice with their smallest required fixtures. Delivery, outgoing attachments, email integration/confirmation, outbound connection and Jido delivery suites. Verify exact bytes/name/MIME, transport failures/timeouts, authorization and confirmation privacy. Copy shared transport fixtures with first consumer.
Branches/paths validated: positive paths, explicit permission rejection, malformed inputs, error propagation and all source regression cases relevant to this slice; standalone compilation against predecessor. Final PR also checks cumulative source parity.
Mocking plan: reuse existing source fixtures/stubs for external APIs; retain real internal boundaries and existing isolation. Do not create redundant fixture frameworks.
Documentations to update for both code and docs/ related content: copy source documentation hunks with the behavior they explain; record source mapping, validation and exceptions in this issue/PR. Do not invent new behavior or rewrite unrelated documentation.
Action reuse assessment: extraction reuses the source implementation's existing Actions/domain operations at the listed paths; no new operation is proposed. Before editing, inspect current module responsibility and dependencies and record reuse evidence for affected operations. Preserve NodeRouter event dispatch, explicit identity checks, configuration resolution and external side-effect boundaries.

Acceptance: slice copies its owned source changes, tests pass independently, no later-PR dependency is missing, source hunks are accounted for, review/coverage/final validation complete, upstream PR merged. Apply epic delivery and restacking instructions. New feature E2E authoring remains subject to the existing zaq-ic9 approval tracking; this split should reuse source tests.
